description: This file implements debouncing logic for inbound messages in the BlueBubbles extension, including message normalization, combining multiple webhook messages, and managing debouncer instances per webhook target.

methods.name: normalizeDebounceMessageText
methods.description: Normalizes message text to a string, defaulting to empty string if not a string.

methods.name: sanitizeDebounceEntry
methods.description: Sanitizes a debounce entry by ensuring message text is a string, replacing with empty string if necessary.

methods.name: combineDebounceEntries
methods.description: Combines multiple debounce entries into a single normalized message, merging text, attachments, timestamps, and reply context.

methods.name: resolveBlueBubblesDebounceMs
methods.description: Resolves the debounce window duration based on configuration and runtime context.

methods.name: createBlueBubblesDebounceRegistry
methods.description: Creates a registry managing debouncers for different webhook targets, handling message coalescing and processing.
